title: Mail Clerks and Mail Machine Operators, Except Postal Service
description: Prepare incoming and outgoing mail for distribution. Time-stamp, open, read, sort, and route incoming mail; and address, seal, stamp, fold, stuff, and affix postage to outgoing mail or packages. Duties may also include keeping necessary records and completed forms.

projection.title: Mail clerks and mail machine operators, except postal service

tasks.text: Lift and unload containers of mail or parcels onto equipment for transportation to sortation stations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical unloading of materials and equipment

tasks.text: Verify that items are addressed correctly, marked with the proper postage, and in suitable condition for processing.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Cross-checks shipping docs against records and rules

dwas.name: Verify shipping documentation.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Clear jams in sortation equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical office equipment servicing

dwas.name: Maintain office equipment in proper operating condition.

tasks.text: Place incoming or outgoing letters or packages into sacks or bins based on destination or type, and place identifying tags on sacks or bins.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Attaching tags to containers is physical

dwas.name: Attach identification information to products, items or containers.

tasks.text: Release packages or letters to customers upon presentation of written notices or other identification.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Drafting aided; authorized signature human

dwas.name: Obtain written authorization to perform activities.

tasks.text: Remove containers of sorted mail or parcels and transfer them to designated areas according to established procedures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical unloading of materials and equipment

tasks.text: Determine manner in which mail is to be sent, and prepare it for delivery to mailing facilities.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Routing analysis from shipping data; human approves

dwas.name: Analyze shipping information to make routing decisions.

tasks.text: Sort and route incoming mail, and collect outgoing mail, using carts as necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Routing physical mail requires sorting by hand

tasks.text: Weigh packages or letters to determine postage needed, using weighing scales and rate charts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical weighing of parcels on scale

dwas.name: Weigh parcels to determine shipping costs.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Fold letters or circulars and insert them in envelopes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual packing for shipping

tasks.text: Seal or open envelopes, by hand or by using machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Preparing physical mail requires hands-on assembly

tasks.text: Accept and check containers of mail or parcels from large volume mailers, couriers, and contractors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Receiving shipments is physical handling and inspection

tasks.text: Add ink, fill paste reservoirs, and change machine ribbons when necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical office equipment servicing

dwas.name: Maintain office equipment in proper operating condition.

tasks.text: Affix postage to packages or letters by hand, or stamp materials, using postage meters.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Preparing physical mail requires hands-on assembly

tasks.text: Answer inquiries regarding shipping or mailing policies.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI explains policies; human handles live questions

dwas.name: Explain regulations, policies, or procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Contact delivery or courier services to arrange delivery of letters and parcels.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI drafts shipping coordination; external negotiation human

dwas.name: Coordinate shipping activities with external parties.

tasks.text: Inspect mail machine output for defects and determine how to eliminate causes of any defects.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Defect inspection of physical items needs presence

dwas.name: Inspect items for damage or defects.

tasks.text: Read production orders to determine types and sizes of items scheduled for printing and mailing.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Extract material requirements from work orders

dwas.name: Read work orders to determine material or setup requirements.

tasks.text: Adjust guides, rollers, loose card inserters, weighing machines, and tying arms, using rules and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on adjustment of physical office equipment

dwas.name: Adjust office equipment to ensure proper operation.

tasks.text: Start machines that automatically feed plates, stencils, or tapes through mechanisms, and observe machine operations to detect any malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Sensor/vision monitoring possible, but physical verification and accountability remain human

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Stamp dates and times of receipt of incoming mail.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sorting physical mail requires hands-on handling

tasks.text: Remove from machines printed materials, such as labeled articles, postmarked envelopes or tape, and folded sheets.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical unloading of materials and equipment

tasks.text: Operate computer-controlled keyboards or voice recognition equipment to direct items according to established routing schemes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating computers is physical interface work

tasks.text: Wrap packages or bundles by hand, or by using tying machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual packing for shipping

tasks.text: Sell mail products, and accept payment for products and mailing charges.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Handling cash/payment collection in person

tasks.text: Operate embossing machines or typewriters to make corrections, additions, and changes to address plates.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Typing documents is core AI text output

tasks.text: Mail merchandise samples or promotional literature in response to requests.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Sending digital materials automatable; physical mailing human

tasks.text: Insert material for printing or addressing into loading racks on machines, select type or die sizes, and position plates, stencils, or tapes in machine magazines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Developing and print equipment operated by hand

dwas.name: Load materials into equipment for processing.
Set up production or processing equipment.
Operate photographic developing or print production equipment.

tasks.text: Use equipment, such as forklifts and automated "trains," to move containers of mail.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Driving forklifts requires real-world navigation and control

dwas.name: Operate equipment or vehicles to clear construction sites or move materials.
